name: Ananda Kanan
aka: Ananda Kanan Ozark Retreat and Conference Center
tradition: Ananda Marga Tantra Yoga (Hindu/tantric meditation lineage)
technique: Personally-instructed mantra meditation (Rajadhiraja Yoga) as the central practice, alongside kiirtan chanting and yoga asanas
influences: Shrii Shrii Anandamurti (founder of Ananda Marga)
teacherAccess: Trained Ananda Marga acharyas (teachers) give personal meditation instruction and lead the organization's scheduled retreats and conferences on site.
retreatOptions: Multi-day Ananda Marga retreats and conferences held on the property (e.g. a spring retreat, an annual summer conference, and a several-day kiirtana retreat), plus self-guided personal retreats of any length in private cabins or shared dormitories (102 beds total across two dorms).
about: Ananda Kanan ("the Garden of Bliss") is a 66-acre rural retreat property in the Missouri Ozarks owned and operated by Ananda Marga, a worldwide spiritual and social-service organization whose core spiritual practice is mantra meditation. Since 1983 the land has hosted Ananda Marga's own multi-day meditation retreats and conferences, including a spring retreat, an annual summer conference, and a multi-day kiirtana (chanting) retreat, run by trained acharyas who also give personal meditation instruction. Alongside these organized programs, the center rents out three private cabins and two dormitories for self-guided personal retreats, with guests free to walk the wooded trails, sit by the on-site lake, and take optional classes in meditation, yoga, or art. Vegetarian meals are served during organized retreats and conferences, while cabin guests typically self-cater using in-cabin kitchens.
schedule: Organized Ananda Marga retreats and conferences occur periodically through the year (spring retreat, July summer conference, August kiirtana retreat); cabins and dorms are otherwise available for self-guided personal retreats year-round.
cost: Cabin and dorm lodging is a fixed nightly/booking fee (booked directly or via Airbnb for the cabins); pricing for organized retreats and conferences varies by event.
foodNotes: Vegetarian meals are served during organized Ananda Marga retreats and conferences; self-guided cabin guests generally self-cater using kitchens in the cabins.
workNotes: No work practice required for personal cabin retreats; not specified for organized retreat programs.
